FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the 14th century.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly! We must be ahead of the curve. We must be... (he gestures grandly)...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his courtiers, all of whom are dressed in the latest fashions from the future. They are all wearing pastel-colored robes with intricate, swirling patterns.

KING
(to his courtiers)
I want our aesthetic to reflect the beauty of the unknown. The beauty of... (he searches for the right words)...of the void.

COURTIER 1 (she)
But, Your Majesty, what about our traditional armor? Our banners?

KING
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, those are so... so... (he searches for the right words)...so last season. I want our armor to be... (he gestures to a nearby servant, who is holding a strange, glowing orb)...glowing.

SERVANT (he)
Yes, Your Majesty. This is a prototype for our new, high-tech armor.

KING
(impressed)
Ah, excellent! And what about our banners? I want them to be... (he searches for the right words)...neon.

COURTIER 2 (he)
But, Your Majesty, that's not possible. We don't have access to neon technology.

KING
(frustrated)
Fine. Use... (he searches for the right words)...glow-in-the-dark paint then.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now transformed. The buildings are adorned with neon lights, and the streets are filled with strange, futuristic contraptions. The king, resplendent in his new, glowing armor, rides through the streets on a... (he searches for the right words)...a hoverbike.

KING
(to his courtiers)
This is it. This is the future. This is... (he searches for the right words)...this is vaporwave.

COURTIER 3 (she)
But, Your Majesty, what about the peasants? They're still wearing their traditional clothing.

KING
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, those are so... so... (he searches for the right words)...so medieval. I want our peasants to be... (he gestures to a nearby peasant, who is wearing a pair of futuristic, high-tech goggles)...futuristic.

PEASANT (he)
Yes, Your Majesty. I'm a... (he searches for the right words)...a cybernetic peasant now.

KING
(impressed)
Ah, excellent! And what about our food? I want our cuisine to be... (he searches for the right words)...synthwave.

COURTIER 4 (he)
But, Your Majesty, we don't have access to synthetic food technology.

KING
(frustrated)
Fine. Use... (he searches for the right words)...glow-in-the-dark ice cream then.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a surreal, dreamlike landscape. The king, surrounded by his courtiers and peasants, all dressed in their futuristic attire, sits down to a feast of glow-in-the-dark ice cream.

KING
(to his courtiers)
This is it. This is the future. This is... (he searches for the right words)...this is vaporwave.
